Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 23899 of 2025
Applicant :- Ramu Yadav
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Santosh Kumar Tiwari

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Ashutosh Srivastava,J.

Heard Sri Santosh Kumar Tiwari, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Rajesh Singh, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.
The present bail application has been filed by the applicant Ramu Yadav with a prayer to enlarge him on bail in Case Crime No. 168 of 2024, under Sections 498A, 306 I.P.C., Police Station Puranderpur, District Maharajganj, during the pendency of trial.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in the present case and is languishing in jail since 27.01.2025.

Learned counsel for the applicant submits that First Information report was lodged on 25.06.2024 with the allegation that the marriage of the daughter of the first informant was solemnized with the applicant in the year 2015 and Gauna was performed in the year 2019.

It has been further submitted that soon after Gauna the applicant and his other family members have demanded a Buffalo and Motorcycle and when the parents of the deceased shows their inability in fulfilling the demand they have started torturing the deceased.

It has been further alleged that on 10.05.2024 the applicant and other family Ramu Yadav vs State Of U.P. on 8 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/151146849/
1 members have murdered the daughter of the first informant.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the cause of death has been shown as Asphyxia due to ante mortem hanging.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the real fact is that the applicant has committed suicide due to depression as she was unable to conceive.
He further submits that no previous complaint with regard to demand of dowry has been lodged by the deceased or his family members.
The applicant has no criminal antecedents and there is no likelihood of their fleeing from course of justice or tampering with evidence in case of release on bail.
Hence, bail has been prayed for.
Per contra, learned A.G.A. has vehemently opposed the prayer for bail but could not dispute the fact that the applicant has no criminal antecedents.

Considering the nature of the offence, material/evidence brought on record, complicity of the accused, severity of punishment, the submissions made by the learned counsel for the parties, the Court is of the view that the applicant has made out a case for bail.

Let the applicant-Ramu Yadav, involved in aforesaid case crime be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond and two local sureties each of the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned, subject to the following conditions:-
1. The applicant will not tamper with the evidence.
2. The applicant will not indulge in any criminal activity.
3. The applicant will not pressurize/intimidate the prosecution witnesses and co-operate in the trial.
4. The applicant will appear regularly on each and every date fixed by the trial court,
unless his personal appearance is exempted through counsel by the court concerned.
In the event of breach of any of the aforesaid conditions, the court below will be at liberty to proceed to cancel his bail.

Order Date :- 8.8.2025 Deepak/
